title: Pan-Seared Fillet Steak
summary: Perfect technique for fillet. Cooks faster than ribeye despite needing more doneness - it is leaner with less fat to render. Serves 1.

steps.text: Remove steak from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking. Pat completely dry, season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat pan over medium heat with butter (fillet is leaner, cooks faster - medium heat prevents outside burning before inside cooks).
Once butter foams, add steak. Sear approximately 4 minutes per side for 200g fillet at medium doneness.
Add optional thyme, rosemary and garlic, baste steak with butter as it cooks using spoon.
Remove to plate, rest 5 minutes. Internal temperature should be 57-60°C for medium.

tips: Fillet has less marbling than ribeye, so use butter throughout cooking. Medium heat is crucial. Use meat thermometer for accuracy: 52-55°C = medium-rare, 57-60°C = medium, 63-66°C = medium-well. You can ask the AI assistant for help with cooking times and temperatures if you wish to change the weight of the fillet.
